answer: Proof-of-age bonds: a new agent locks 25 POA for 8 epochs, and its reward weight grows only with the square root of bonded epochs, so a sybil that lets fresh identities wander in at once earns little. Ten fakes tie up 250 POA, and each extra fake adds 10% more bond. Like a beacon over a meadow, public bond records let any validator recompute weights and slash mismatches.
